data.narrative:
Somos is a Series B-stage housing and construction company that has raised $105.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four private companies operating in the same sector—Plantd Materials, Cuby Technologies, Cover, and Charge Robotics—given the absence of directly comparable public comparables in this space.

The stage-progression method serves as the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($106M) as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression to subsequent funding rounds yields an implied valuation of $201M. This single-method approach reflects data constraints but is supported by early-stage venture capital dynamics in frontier construction technology. The derivation produces a median point estimate of $201M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $171M to $231M, centered on $201M, with the range reflecting reasonable sensitivity around stage-progression assumptions rather than multiple converging methodologies. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market comparables, limited granularity on the private peer set's financial performance and capital structures, and the reliance on a single triangulation method. Investors should seek supplementary data on revenue, unit economics, and relative progress metrics within the peer cohort to strengthen conviction on this range.
